text_1981: In the name of GOD, Most Gracious, Most Merciful.
text_1989: In the name of God, Most Gracious, Most Merciful
text_ref: In the name of GOD, Most Gracious, Most Merciful.

text_1981: What are they questioning?
text_1989: What are they questioning?
text_ref: What are they questioning?

text_1981: The great event.
text_1989: The great event.
text_ref: The great event.

text_1981: About which they dispute.
text_1989: That is disputed by them.
text_ref: That is disputed by them.

text_1981: Indeed, they will find out.
text_1989: Indeed, they will find out.
text_ref: Indeed, they will find out.

text_1981: Then, they will really find out.
text_1989: Most assuredly, they will find out.
text_ref: Most assuredly, they will find out.

text_1981: Did we not make the earth habitable?
text_1989: Did we not make the earth habitablel
text_ref: Did we not make the earth habitable?

text_1981: And the mountains stabilizers?
text_1989: And the mountains stabilizers?
text_ref: And the mountains stabilizers?

text_1981: We created you male and female.
text_1989: We created you as mates (for one another).
text_ref: We created you as mates (for one another).

text_1981: We made the sleep for your rest.
text_1989: We created sleeping so you can rest.
text_ref: We created sleeping so you can rest.

text_1981: We made the night a cover.
text_1989: We made the night a cover.
text_ref: We made the night a cover.

text_1981: We made the day for business.
text_1989: And the day to seek provisions.
text_ref: And the day to seek provisions.

text_1981: We built above you seven formidable heavens.
text_1989: We built above you seven universes.
text_ref: We built above you seven universes.

text_1981: We made a bright lamp.
text_1989: We created a bright lamp.
text_ref: We created a bright lamp.

text_1981: We send down from the clouds pure water.
text_1989: We send down from the clouds pouring water.
text_ref: We send down from the clouds pouring water.

text_1981: To produce grains and vegetation.
text_1989: To produce with it grains and plants.
text_ref: To produce with it grains and plants.

text_1981: And dense gardens.
text_1989: And various orchards.
text_ref: And various orchards.

text_1981: The day of judgment is predetermined.
text_1989: The Day of Decision is appointed.
text_ref: The Day of Decision is appointed.

text_1981: That is the day when the horn is blown, whereupon you come in throngs.
text_1989: The day the horn is blown, and you come in throngs.
text_ref: The day the horn is blown, and you come in throngs.

text_1981: The heaven will be opened into many gates.
text_1989: The heaven will be opened like gates.
text_ref: The heaven will be opened like gates.

text_1981: The mountains will be wiped out, as if they were a mirage.
text_1989: The mountains will be removed, as if they were a mirage.
text_ref: The mountains will be removed, as if they were a mirage.

text_1981: Hell is inevitable.
text_1989: Gehenna is inevitable.
text_ref: Gehenna is inevitable.

text_1981: For the transgressors, it will be the final abode.
text_1989: For the transgressors; it will be their abode.
text_ref: For the transgressors; it will be their abode.

text_1981: They stay in it for ages.
text_1989: They stay in it for ages.
text_ref: They stay in it for ages.

text_1981: They never taste coolness in it, nor a drink.
text_1989: They never taste in it coolness, nor a drink.
text_ref: They never taste in it coolness, nor a drink.

text_1981: Only lava and bitter food.
text_1989: Only an inferno, and bitter food.
text_ref: Only an inferno, and bitter food.

text_1981: This is their just retribution.
text_1989: A just requital.
text_ref: A just requital.

text_1981: They did not expect any reckoning.
text_1989: They never expected to be held accountable.
text_ref: They never expected to be held accountable.

text_1981: They have rejected our revelations.
text_1989: And utterly rejected our signs.
text_ref: And utterly rejected our signs.

text_1981: Everything they had done we recorded in a record.
text_1989: We counted everything in a record.
text_ref: We counted everything in a record.

text_1981: So taste, we will only increase your retribution.
text_1989: Suffer the consequences; we will only increase your retribution. 0 2677
text_ref: Suffer the consequences; we will only increase your retribution.

text_1981: The righteous have deserved a reward.
text_1989: The righteous have deserved a reward.
text_ref: The righteous have deserved a reward.

text_1981: Gardens and grapes.
text_1989: Orchards and grapes.
text_ref: Orchards and grapes.

text_1981: And magnificent spouses.
text_1989: Magnificent spouses.
text_ref: Magnificent spouses.

text_1981: And pure drinks.
text_1989: Delicious drinks.
text_ref: Delicious drinks.

text_1981: They will not hear any vain talk or lies.
text_1989: They will never hear in it any nonsense or lies.
text_ref: They will never hear in it any nonsense or lies.

text_1981: This is the recompense from your Lord; a well deserved gift. 37.
text_1989: A reward from your Lord; a generous recompense. 583
text_ref: A reward from your Lord; a generous recompense.

text_1981: Lord of the heavens and the earth, and everything between them. The Most Gracious. No one can abrogate His decisions.
text_1989: Lord of the heavens and the earth, and everything between them. The Most Gracious. No one can abrogate His decisions.
text_ref: Lord of the heavens and the earth, and everything between them. The Most Gracious. No one can abrogate His decisions.

text_1981: The day will come when the Spirit and the angels will stand in a row. None will speak except those permitted by the Most Gracious, and they will utter only what is right.
text_1989: The day will come when the Spirit and the angels will stand in a row. utter only what is right.
text_ref: The day will come when the Spirit and the angels will stand in a row. None will speak except those permitted by the Most Gracious, and they will utter only what is right.

text_1981: Such is the inevitable day. Whoever wills let him take refuge in his Lord.
text_1989: Such is the inevitable day. Whoever wills let him take refuge in his Lord.
text_ref: Such is the inevitable day. Whoever wills let him take refuge in his Lord.

text_1981: We have sufficiently warned you about an imminent retribution. That is the day when everyone will examine what his hands have sent forth, and the disbeliever will say, "Oh, I wish I were dust."
text_1989: We have sufficiently warned you about an imminent retribution. That is the day when everyone will examine what his hands have sent forth, and the disbeliever will say, “Oh, I wish I were dust.” — ^
text_ref: We have sufficiently warned you about an imminent retribution. That is the day when everyone will examine what his hands have sent forth, and the disbeliever will say, "Oh, I wish I were dust."
